outcome: The accepted Control Panel and workspace-navigation design is implemented across phone through ultra-wide layouts
owner_impact: The workspace now has three clear peer destinations: Control Panel, Simulation and Edit Experiment. The duplicate EXPERIMENT / Control panel heading is gone. Current Experiment now reads in one stable order: title, only meaningful exceptional access state, collection metadata, then Browse experiments and Organize. Normal ownership is implicit instead of shown as My Experiment. Research curation is renamed Professor controls while preserving Showcase and Capability requests.

next.text: This accepted #273 design correction is finished. The UI/UX domain returns to living/dormant status until new concrete use evidence appears.

technical_evidence: Workspace navigation exposes Control Panel, Simulation and Edit Experiment with one active destination and keeps Help/Account as utilities.
Navigation remains visible and single-line across responsive layouts; narrow layouts reflow the workspace nav beneath the brand instead of hiding it in the utility drawer.
The visible duplicate Control Panel heading was removed while the panel retains accessible naming.
Current Experiment uses a stable title → access → collection → actions hierarchy; owned/editable state is hidden as the default.
Browse experiments is the primary library/finder action and Organize remains secondary in the same action group.
Professor controls preserves the existing Showcase and Capability requests functions.
Responsive production smoke checks narrow phone, foldable/wider mobile, ordinary desktop and ultra-wide desktop using the shared browser harness.
Scientific/runtime, revision/Working-copy/autosave, sharing, Showcase, capability-request and collection semantics are unchanged.

The production repair aligns both application-shell and responsive smoke gates with the accepted three-destination navigation and waits for the initialized Experiment finder before viewport assertions.

Responsive smoke verifies metadata ownership inside the Current Experiment context block and the context-before-actions relationship, matching the implemented hierarchy without relying on a brittle nested-node ordering comparison.
The obsolete Showcase-era Current Experiment action wrapper is removed after its controls are relocated, leaving one authoritative action group for responsive hierarchy verification.
